text: Completed: scontrol key-boundary parsing is covered for spaced, delimiter-bearing, empty, Unicode, and unknown values; structured squeue now preserves every raw JSON field, attaches bounded full-stream evidence, filters authority to requested identities, isolates malformed unrelated records, and remains fail-closed for malformed requested records. Added synthetic provenance-stamped edge fixtures with exact byte counts and SHA-256 digests. Verified focused parser/scheduler suites (30 tests), sbt checkFormatting test (302 tests passed), and git diff --check.
